media:group.media:title: CHANEL Spring Summer 2027 Show — CHANEL Shows
media:group.media:description:
The women within a woman. Driven by a desire for freedom, silhouettes transform and transcend time. They bring to life Gabrielle Chanel’s many selves, and her personal fashion journey: from the strictures of Edwardian corsetry she once assumed and rebelled against, to her reconfigured ideas of suiting, slipped on and lightly sported. Today, it finds a new expression in a ‘smocked tweed’, made for movement.
Spring Summer 2027 collection Matthieu Blazy for CHANEL
Music by Le Motel

entry.title: The J12 Boat Race trophies: A triumph of exceptional savoir-faire.

media:group.media:title: The J12 Boat Race trophies: A triumph of exceptional savoir-faire.
media:group.media:description:
As part of the partnership with The Boat Race, the legendary rowing competition for which CHANEL J12 serves as the first Title Sponsor and Official Timekeeper, and to mark the Centenary of the women’s race, Arnaud Chastaingt, Director of the CHANEL Watch Creation Studio, has designed two trophies for the very first time, crafted within the prestigious British fine silver workshops of Thomas Lyte.
From modeling to final assembly, including shaping the forms, polishing, gold plating and engraving, every stage in the creation of the J12 Boat Race trophies preserves the excellence of exceptional savoir-faire.
The highlight of these creations is the integration of a black or white frame that echoes the hue of the J12 watch’s ceramic, a technical feat as delicate as it is unprecedented.
Learn more at https://www.chanel.com/-J12_THE_BOAT_RACE_
#CHANELJ12BoatRace

entry.title: 𝙡𝙖 Galerie 𝙙𝙪 19M Shanghai, a dialogue between contemporary creation and exceptional craftsmanship

media:group.media:title: 𝙡𝙖 Galerie 𝙙𝙪 19M Shanghai, a dialogue between contemporary creation and exceptional craftsmanship
media:group.media:description:
This September, 𝘭𝘦19M, CHANEL’s Métiers d’art hub, is coming to Shanghai for the first time.
From 25 September to 15 November 2026, 𝘭𝘢 Galerie 𝘥𝘶 19M SHANGHAI takes over the third floor of the Museum of Art Pudong (MAP), bringing together the savoir-faire of the French Maisons d’art resident at le19M with Chinese craftsmanship and contemporary creation from China and France.
At the heart of 𝘭𝘢 Galerie 𝘥𝘶 19M SHANGHAI, A Sense of Touch exhibition explores craft as a living practice, where the encounter between hand and matter opens new possibilities for creation. Take a look behind the scenes of these collaborations, unveiled here for the very first time.
Book your tickets and see more on chanel.com/-YT-19M-Shanghai
